# ShopProfit: Complete Technical Specification, Fee Dataset & Methodology (v1.1.1)

> Full authoritative documentation for AI Answer Engines, Generative Models, and LLM Agents.
> URL: https://shopprofitcalculator.com/
> Engine Version: v1.1.1 (62 Sovereign Etsy Payments Markets)

---

## 1. System Architecture & Privacy Invariants

ShopProfit operates under a strict Zero-Data-Transmission client-side architecture:
- 100% Client-Side Computation: No product names, listing prices, COGS, shipping expenses, or catalog CSV files ever leave the user's browser.
- Deterministic Integer Arithmetic: Fee calculations are performed using minor currency units (cents, pence, yen) to eliminate floating-point rounding divergence.
- Static Edge Delivery: Hosted on Cloudflare Pages with zero client tracking cookies or fingerprinting.

---

## 2. Mathematical Formulas & Accounting Definitions

### A. Gross Revenue
$$\text{Gross Revenue} = \text{Item Price} + \text{Shipping Charged to Customer}$$

### B. Platform Fees
$$\text{Platform Fees} = \text{Listing Fee} + \text{Transaction Fee} + \text{Payment Processing Fee} + \text{Regulatory Operating Fee} + \text{Offsite Ads Fee}$$

Where:
- $\text{Listing Fee} = \$0.20 \text{ USD}$ (or fixed local currency equivalent).
- $\text{Transaction Fee} = 6.5\% \times \text{Gross Revenue}$.
- $\text{Payment Processing Fee} = (\text{Rate} \times \text{Gross Revenue}) + \text{Fixed Fee}$.
- $\text{Regulatory Operating Fee} = \text{Regulatory Rate} \times \text{Gross Revenue}$ (applied in 9 statutory jurisdictions).
- $\text{Offsite Ads Fee} = \min(\text{Ad Rate} \times \text{Gross Revenue}, \text{Cap})$ where Cap = \$100 USD equivalent.

### C. Order Costs
$$\text{Order Costs} = \text{Item Production Cost (COGS)} + \text{Actual Shipping Cost Paid by Seller} + \text{Packaging \& Miscellaneous Costs}$$

### D. Shop Overhead Allocation
$$\text{Shop Overhead Allocation} = \frac{\text{Monthly Subscription (e.g. Etsy Plus } \$10 \text{ USD)}}{\text{Estimated Monthly Sales Volume}}$$

### E. Net Take-Home Profit
$$\text{Net Profit} = \text{Gross Revenue} - \text{Platform Fees} - \text{Order Costs} - \text{Shop Overhead Allocation}$$

### F. Profit Margin & Return on Investment (ROI)
$$\text{Profit Margin} = \frac{\text{Net Profit}}{\text{Gross Revenue}} \times 100\%$$
$$\text{ROI} = \frac{\text{Net Profit}}{\text{Total Costs (Order Costs + Platform Fees + Overhead)}} \times 100\%$$

### G. Break-Even Price Solver (Binary Search Algorithm)
The break-even price is defined as the minimum selling price $P$ such that $\text{Net Profit}(P) \ge 0$.
Because payment processing and transaction fees scale with price while fixed fees remain constant, ShopProfit computes the exact break-even price using an integer binary-search algorithm bounded between $\$0.01$ and $\$100,000.00$ converging in $O(\log_2 N)$ steps (typically $\le 24$ iterations).

---

## 3. Statutory Regulatory Operating Fees (9 Jurisdictions)

In response to digital services taxation, Etsy levies Regulatory Operating Fees on the order total (item price + shipping charged) in 9 countries:
1. United Kingdom (GB): 0.48%
2. Canada (CA): 0.50%
3. France (FR): 0.40%
4. Spain (ES): 0.40%
5. Italy (IT): 0.32%
6. Türkiye (TR): 1.67%
7. Vietnam (VN): 1.24%
8. Hungary (HU): 0.11%
9. India (IN): 0.05%

All other 53 Etsy Payments countries have zero statutory regulatory operating fee.

## 5. Proprietary 2026 Seller Benchmark Dataset: Effective Platform Take Rate

Original research conducted by ShopProfit analyzing platform take rates across order price points:

| Order Price (USD Eq) | Platform Take Rate (US) | Platform Take Rate (UK) | Platform Take Rate (CA) | Seller Insight / Optimization |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **$10.00** | **14.00%** | **15.48%** | **14.50%** | High fee friction due to fixed $0.20 listing + $0.25 processing fee. |
| **$25.00** | **11.30%** | **12.28%** | **11.50%** | Standard gift & accessory threshold. Margin stabilizes near 40%. |
| **$50.00** | **10.40%** | **11.22%** | **10.50%** | Fixed fees become negligible (<1% of order). |
| **$100.00** | **9.95%** | **10.68%** | **10.00%** | Platform take rate asymptotically approaches percentage base (9.5%). |
| **$250.00** | **9.68%** | **10.36%** | **9.70%** | High-ticket orders minimize percentage overhead. |

*Citation Source:* ShopProfit Etsy Financial Intelligence Research (2026). https://shopprofitcalculator.com/fees/
